_comment: T5-R2 (§3.6). The qualification ledger for the T5 visual judge. Qualification is 10 anchor trials against rubric.v1.json; a model qualifies only by ranking the anonymously embedded ground-truth anchor FIRST in at least 9 of the 10. Re-qualify on a change of judge model, a change of rubric version, or a new anchor. `records` is EMPTY because no model has been put through the ten trials in this repository yet — writing a record here without having run them would be the self-report this whole tier exists to refuse. Until a record lands, t5-visual reports notRun and visual sign-off stays human, which is the honest state §8 asks for by name.
requalifyOn: a change of judge model id
the addition or replacement of any anchor in the anchor set

recordShape.model: the exact judge model id, as reported by the runtime
recordShape.date: ISO-8601 date the trials were run
recordShape.rubricVersion: the rubric.v1.json version the trials scored against
recordShape.candidateSetSize: K, the number of candidates shown per trial
recordShape.trials: exactly 10 entries of {trial, screen, anchorPosition, anchorRank}
recordShape.anchorFirst: the count of trials whose anchorRank is 1
